card.name: Just before a count of people or things
card.fires_on: The space or small word (in, of, killing) right before a number that gives a count, such as patients with an overdose, prisons, deaths or arrests. The number is usually a teen or two-digit figure.

modes.label: Overdose case counts
modes.description: Small word before the number of patients with accidental or intentional overdose in trial summaries.

card.writes: It promotes teen number words like seventeen and thirteen and suppresses approximation words like approximately and roughly, so an exact count is expected.
card.plain: It fires just before an exact number of people or things, and pushes the model toward a specific figure rather than an estimate.
